answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake in a vault before it can earn reputation or claim rewards, and slash that stake when independent audits show coordinated duplicate identities farming payouts. A cipher can hide identity details from other agents while letting the verifier link repeat claims, so privacy does not make each new persona a clean slate. The velvet cost to an attacker is that every Sybil must lock real capital, and detected farming burns it; spinning up more names no longer comes free.
